raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pikepdf
  version: "10.12.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: cbc790243a333a2c87bb4c1a69e3d7036b4a7f43c7fafc8ec7cee06985b48ae9

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - if: win
      then:
        - set "CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja"
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM=
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_TOOLSET=
        - set "INCLUDE=%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\include;%INCLUDE%"
        - set "LIB=%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib;%LIB%"
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
      else:
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - cmake
    - if: unix
      then:
        - make
    - if: win
      then:
        - ninja
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - nanobind >=2.0
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - scikit-build-core >=0.10
    - nanobind >=2.0
    - qpdf >=12.3.2
  run:
    - python
    - pillow >=10.0.1
    - lxml >=4.8
    - packaging

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pikepdf
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: MPL-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: A Python library for reading and writing PDF, powered by qpdf
  homepage: https://github.com/pikepdf/pikepdf
  repository: https://github.com/pikepdf/pikepdf
  documentation: https://pikepdf.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - thewchan
    - carlodri
